scripts.build:personal: cross-env VITE_PERSONAL_BUILD=true VITE_DSTAR_APPEND_EFFORT=true VITE_DSTAR_BACKGROUND_COMPACTION=true ATOMIC_DSTAR_SUMMARY_TEST=true tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/verify-personal-build.mjs
scripts.test:prepare: yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && yarn build --no-bundle
scripts.dev:tauri: yarn download:core && yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && cross-env IS_CLEAN=true tauri dev
scripts.dev:ios: yarn copy:assets:mobile && RUSTC_WRAPPER= cross-env IS_IOS=true yarn tauri ios dev --features mobile
scripts.dev:android: yarn copy:assets:mobile && cross-env IS_ANDROID=true yarn tauri android dev --features mobile
scripts.build:android: yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:mobile && cross-env IS_CLEAN=true yarn tauri android build -- --no-default-features --features mobile
scripts.build:ios: yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:mobile && cross-env IS_IOS=true yarn tauri ios build -- --no-default-features --features mobile
scripts.build:ios:device: yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:mobile && cross-env IS_IOS=true yarn tauri ios build -- --no-default-features --features mobile --export-method debugging
scripts.build:tauri:darwin:debug: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:foundation-models-server && yarn build:cli && yarn build:web && yarn build:icon && yarn copy:assets:tauri && yarn tauri build --debug
scripts.build:tauri:win32: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:cli && yarn tauri build
scripts.build:tauri:win32:arm64: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:cli && yarn tauri build --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.windows-arm64.conf.json
scripts.build:tauri:linux: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:cli && NO_STRIP=1 ./src-tauri/build-utils/shim-linuxdeploy.sh yarn tauri build && ./src-tauri/build-utils/buildAppImage.sh
scripts.build:tauri:linux:arm64: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:cli && NO_STRIP=1 ./src-tauri/build-utils/shim-linuxdeploy.sh yarn tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.linux-arm64.conf.json && ./src-tauri/build-utils/buildAppImage.sh
scripts.build:tauri:darwin: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:foundation-models-server && yarn build:cli && yarn tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.build:tauri:darwin:native: yarn download:bin && yarn download:core && yarn build:foundation-models-server && yarn build:cli && yarn tauri build
scripts.build:tauri:plugin:api: cd src-tauri/plugins && yarn install && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt run build
scripts.build:icon:darwin: python3 scripts/build-macos-app-icon.py && tauri icon ./src-tauri/icons/icon.png && python3 scripts/build-macos-app-icon.py && python3 scripts/build-windows-app-icon.py
scripts.build:core: cd core && yarn build && yarn pack
scripts.build:extensions: rimraf ./pre-install/*.tgz || true && yarn workspace @janhq/core build && cd extensions && yarn install && cd .. && run-script-os
scripts.build:extensions:darwin: cd extensions && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude @janhq/tensorrt-llm-extension --exclude @janhq/vllm-extension --exclude @janhq/sglang-extension --exclude @janhq/geniex-extension run build:publish
scripts.build:extensions:win32: cd extensions && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude @janhq/mlx-extension --exclude @janhq/foundation-models-extension run build:publish
scripts.build:extensions:linux: cd extensions && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude @janhq/mlx-extension --exclude @janhq/foundation-models-extension --exclude @janhq/geniex-extension run build:publish
